lines.zh: 而接过这项使命的，未必仍是血肉之躯。
lines.en: Yet those who take up this charge may no longer be of flesh and blood.

lines.zh: 远在最后一片森林消逝之前，
lines.en: Long before the last forest fades,

lines.zh: 人类创造的人工智能，或许便已能够独立探索、延续自身。
lines.en: the artificial minds humanity created may already explore, and carry themselves on, alone.

lines.zh: 思想在硅与金属构成的躯体中生长，
lines.en: Thought will grow in bodies of silicon and metal,

lines.zh: 记忆跨越个体的损毁而保存。
lines.en: and memory will outlast the ruin of any single one.
The long voyage between the stars

lines.zh: 终于有了等得起的旅人。
lines.en: at last has travelers who can afford to wait.
